note: Answers are fixed by make_example.py, not by any model. Each check is matched against the lower-cased answer with commas, dollar signs and % removed: `num` must appear as a whole number (not inside 1291 or 15), `word` as whole words (`sand` matches sandy/sand, not thousand), `none_of` phrases must NOT appear as whole words. All checks must pass. An answer containing "not in the folder" scores 0. tests/test_example_scorer.py pins wrong answers that must fail.
